signingMatrix.status: DRAFT_FOR_BOARD_REVIEW — no appointment, delegation, bank mandate or legal signatory is created by this matrix
signingMatrix.governingRule: A signature is valid within IRPA only when the actor's current appointment, approved job description, applicable delegation/resolution, instrument-specific controls and server-side verification all authorise that exact action.
authorityChain: Board of Directors — governance and reserved decisions
Executive Director — overall management authority; accountable to the Board
Directorate / Department Head — delegated departmental management
Unit Head / Supervisor — expressly sub-delegated operational authority
Officer / Specialist — assigned preparation, verification or execution duties

rows.category: Board resolutions, governance instruments and constitutional matters
rows.review: Board committee / governance review as required
rows.recommend: Relevant committee or Executive Director where appropriate
rows.sign: Only office-holder(s) expressly authorised by Constitution, resolution or legal instrument; not assigned by this matrix
rows.release: Board Secretariat after certification and approval
rows.evidence: Constitution, approved Board resolution, certified minutes and specific signatory delegation
rows.limit: No individual Board office may exercise collective Board authority without express delegation.

rows.category: Organisational strategy, annual plans, budgets and management policies
rows.approve: Board where reserved; otherwise Executive Director within Board-approved delegation
rows.sign: Executive Director or specifically delegated officer for management instruments
rows.evidence: Board-approved strategy, budget, policy or written ED delegation
rows.limit: Any reserved matter or unbudgeted/out-of-limit commitment escalates to Board.

rows.category: Routine departmental operations and programme delivery
rows.approve: Department head only within written ED delegation
rows.sign: Department head or named delegate within documented scope
rows.evidence: Approved job description, current appointment, ED delegation, approved workplan/budget and workflow record
rows.limit: Escalate cross-departmental, exceptional, unbudgeted or above-limit decisions to ED.

rows.category: Human resources, recruitment and personnel decisions
rows.approve: Executive Director within approved HR policy; Board for ED appointment or reserved senior appointments
rows.sign: ED or specifically delegated HR signatory; employment contracts subject to legal authority
rows.evidence: Approved HR policy, job description, recruitment record, budget and written delegation
rows.limit: No employee may approve own appointment, remuneration or disciplinary outcome; reserved appointments escalate to Board.

rows.category: Finance, expenditure, payments and bank instruments
rows.review: Independent finance review and supporting-document verification
rows.approve: Authorised approver under approved financial delegation
rows.sign: Current bank-mandated signatories only for bank instruments; other instruments require written legal/management authority
rows.release: Treasury/payment releaser separate from preparer and approver
rows.evidence: Approved budget, finance policy, procurement evidence where applicable, approval trail and current bank mandate
rows.limit: This matrix assigns no monetary thresholds or bank signatories. Bank mandate controls bank execution; no self-approval; separate preparation, approval and release.

rows.category: Procurement, quotations, tender evaluation and contracts
rows.approve: Approving authority under approved procurement policy and delegation
rows.sign: Named contract signatory under specific written delegation and applicable law
rows.evidence: Procurement plan, approved requisition, evaluation record, budget, award approval, contract and delegation
rows.limit: No person may improperly combine requisition, evaluation, approval and contract execution; value thresholds remain unassigned pending approved policy.

rows.category: Research ethics, restricted data and research-data release
rows.review: Research governance, ethics and data-protection review
rows.approve: Named authority under approved research ethics and data-governance policy
rows.sign: Research Director or expressly delegated authority where required
rows.release: Named data custodian after clearance and access conditions
rows.evidence: Classification, ethics/clearance record, purpose, data-sharing approval, named approver and audit log
rows.limit: Restricted by default; no release based only on role name, publication status or generic Administrator access.

rows.approve: Approver under written Communications delegation; ED retains overall management oversight
rows.sign: Not normally applicable; approval identity and content version are recorded
rows.evidence: Approved content, reviewer/approver, version, channel, publication permission and release audit
rows.limit: Author and approver separation; publishing remains disabled unless expressly enabled; no role title alone grants publication authority.

rows.category: Asset, records and data disposal / transfer
rows.review: Finance, records, IT or compliance review as relevant
rows.approve: Executive Director within delegation; Board where reserved or material
rows.sign: Named authorised officer for transfer/disposal instrument
rows.release: Custodian after approval and register update
rows.evidence: Asset/data register, valuation or classification, policy, approval and recipient record
rows.limit: No disposal, transfer or deletion outside approved retention, asset and data-governance controls.

universalControls: Authority follows the approved reporting line and documented delegation, not seniority or a job title alone.
Board authority is collective unless a valid resolution expressly delegates a defined power.
Executive Director is the overall management authority and reports to the Board.
Departmental heads exercise only authority expressly delegated by the Executive Director.
Sub-delegation is prohibited unless the written delegation permits it.
Every approval/signature must be attributable to the actor's active appointment and capacity at the time.
No self-approval; incompatible preparation, review, approval, signing and release duties must be separated.
Acting appointments require written scope, start/end dates and approving authority.
A person with multiple roles must select the capacity relevant to the action; roles do not combine automatically.
The matrix does not replace the Constitution, law, bank mandate, procurement policy or Board resolutions.

technicalModel.authoritySource: Current authenticated Member and Employee register entries for the signer, combined with approved organisational appointment and delegation evidence before an action is authorised.
technicalModel.ambiguousTitles: Exact-match only; ambiguous director titles are not normalised into one another.
technicalModel.administratorRecognition: Administrator mode is derived from authenticated administrator context; the job title Administrator alone cannot select administrator mode or grant administrator authority.
technicalModel.limitation: The technical selector and verifier do not appoint signatories or override Board resolutions, bank mandates, approved delegations, separation of duties, or server-side controls.
technicalModel.multiRoleCapacitySelection: Required; evaluate the selected capacity and its delegation independently

Verify counts, references and audit continuity
Production migration requires separate RUN MIGRATION approval
migration.rollback: Restore verified pre-migration backup and prior mapping snapshot; no production target selected.

authorityFramework.governingPrinciple: The Board governs; the Executive Director manages; departments execute within documented delegations; job descriptions define authority and limits.

governance.authority: Board of Directors acting collectively under the Constitution, approved policies and recorded resolutions.
reservedMatters: Approval of annual plans and budgets where reserved to the Board
Appointment, supervision and accountability of the Executive Director
Approval of policies and organisational delegations
Matters expressly reserved by law, Constitution or Board resolution
governance.limits: Individual Board offices do not independently exercise collective Board powers unless a valid resolution or written delegation expressly authorises the action.

management.authority: Executive Director is the overall management authority and reports to the Board of Directors.
responsibilities: Lead and coordinate all organisational departments and staff
Implement Board resolutions, strategy, approved plans and budgets
Issue, document and monitor departmental delegations
Approve management decisions within approved policy, budget and delegated limits
Escalate reserved, exceptional or out-of-limit matters to the Board
management.limits: The Executive Director cannot override Board-reserved matters, law, the Constitution, bank mandates, approved procurement controls or documented separation-of-duties requirements.

reportingRules.default: All management directorates and departments report administratively through the Executive Director; the Executive Director reports to the Board.
reportingRules.governance: The Board Secretariat reports to the Board for governance business. The Executive Office supports the Executive Director and reports to the Executive Director.
reportingRules.independentAssurance: Internal Audit and Assurance has functional access/reporting to the Board for independence and administrative coordination through the Executive Director; it must not audit its own work.
reportingRules.researchIndependence: Research, Statistics and Knowledge retains professional/ethical independence for research integrity and clearance, with administrative accountability to the Executive Director and any Board oversight required by policy.

departmentalHierarchy.rule: This is a reporting template, not a claim that every layer is staffed. Each approved department must identify its actual head, subordinate units, incumbents, reporting line and acting arrangements before permissions are activated.
departmentalHierarchy.delegation: A department head may sub-delegate only where the Executive Director's written delegation expressly permits it; every sub-delegation must be written, scoped, time-bound where appropriate, recorded and revocable.
departmentalHierarchy.vacancy: A vacant or unconfirmed position carries no authority. A unit name, department label, seniority inference or job title alone never grants approval or signature rights.

requiredFields: Permitted initiation, review, verification, recommendation, approval, signature and release actions
Financial and procurement limits with currency and period, if formally approved
Delegation source, effective date, expiry/review date and revocation status
jobDescriptionAuthorityStandard.rule: Runtime permissions must be derived from an approved job description plus the current appointment and any required written delegation; all applicable controls must pass.
jobDescriptionAuthorityStandard.default: DENY unless appointment, job description, delegation, workflow scope and server-side policy all authorise the action.

required: Applicable Board resolution or Executive Director written delegation
Approved policy/procedure and budget authority where relevant
